list.title: Maps
list.subtitle: Reusable battle maps with walls and bars
list.emptyDescription: Create a map, draw walls and bars, then reuse it in battles.

create.title: New map
create.description: Name and grid size. You can change them in the editor.
create.name: Name

editor.name: Map name
editor.conflict: The map was changed elsewhere — reload the page to get the latest version, then redo your edits
editor.desktopOnly: The map editor is desktop-only — open this page on a computer

import.help: Imports the map image, grid scale, walls and doors into this draft. Save the map to persist it.
import.failed: Could not read this map file.

warnings.outOfBounds: {count, plural, one {# wall segment outside the map was skipped} other {# wall segments outside the map were skipped}}
warnings.border: {count, plural, one {# wall on the map border was skipped} other {# walls on the map border were skipped}}
warnings.zeroLength: {count, plural, one {# zero-length wall was skipped} other {# zero-length walls were skipped}}

panelDescription.background: Import a UVTT file or set the background image and grid scale.
panelDescription.cells: Mark blocked cells and hazardous areas.
panelDescription.edges: Draw walls, bars, and interactive doors along cell edges.
panelDescription.art: Paint floors, walls, doors and lights; the art is baked into the map background.
panelDescription.objects: Choose an object and a tool, then paint on the map.

art.intro: Paint floors, walls, doors and lights right in the editor — the art is baked into the map image. Walls and doors become battle mechanics.

toolHint.floor-fill: Click to fill a connected floor area.
toolHint.room: Drag a rectangle: floor with walls around the perimeter.
toolHint.wall-erase: Removes walls together with openings on them.
toolHint.opening: Click walls to place a door, window, bars or portcullis.
toolHint.blocked: Click to place or remove rubble.
toolHint.light: Click to add a light; drag the handles to move.
toolHint.stamp: Click to place the chosen stamp; R and F turn the ghost.
toolHint.stamp-select: Click a stamp to select it, drag to move, use the handles to rotate and scale.

art.noLightSelected: Select a light on the map or click to add one.
art.bakeStale: The background is out of date — bake it.

confirmDetach.title: Detach art?
confirmDetach.body: The art scene will be deleted. Walls stay on the baked background but are edited separately as regular walls.

bakeFailed.too-large: The map is too large to bake in the browser. Reduce the map size.
bakeFailed.canvas: The browser could not create a canvas for baking.
bakeFailed.encode: Could not encode the baked image.

notice.openingNeedsWall: Openings can only be placed on walls.
notice.terrainLimit: The rubble limit for this map is reached.
notice.lightLimit: The light limit for this map is reached.

validation.tooManyDoors: Too many doors on the map.
validation.outOfBounds: An art element is outside the map.
validation.tooManyBlocked: Too many blocked cells on the map.

stamps.limit: The stamp limit for this map is reached.
stamps.hints: R / Shift+R rotate, F flip, [ ] order, Ctrl/Cmd+D duplicate, Delete remove, wheel scales.

catalog.title: Map catalog
catalog.description: Choose a community map to add a campaign-owned copy.
catalog.previewFailed: Could not load or validate this map preview.
catalog.importUnavailable: The preview is available, but this map's format or geometry is not supported by the editor yet.

grid.label: Grid
grid.hexHint: The grid type cannot be changed after the map is created. Hex maps have no maze or textures.
